name: spqr-field-variants
description: First pre-key message whose post-quantum field was changed by the generator; the generator then derived the message keys the way CRS-04b says a receiver does (post_quantum_message_key_used_by_generator is the HKDF salt, null means no salt), encrypted a new body and computed a valid MAC. The oracle responder outcome is shown. Accepted cases confirm the derivation; rejected cases show which post-quantum field forms a receiver refuses. failure_reason is a neutral category of the oracle rejection (see CRS-04b §12), not oracle error text.
